paper_metadata.title: Quantum Computing’s Role in Finance, Consumer Behaviour, Blockchain, Digital Marketing, Stock Market Predictions

experiments.description: Review-level discussion of quantum-enhanced smart grid optimization using QAOA, VQE, and quantum annealing, including cited industrial pilots from Siemens Energy, TenneT, and E.ON/Terra Quantum.

algorithm.variant: Quantum optimization for smart grid routing, congestion forecasting, and prosumer-network simulation

problem_formulation.objective_function: Optimize grid dispatch, switching configurations, congestion forecasting, load redistribution, and voltage stability under renewable integration constraints.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Not specified; described conceptually as optimization over grid constraints and load balancing.

problem_instance.description: Smart-grid optimization problems discussed in the review: unit commitment, load balancing, grid congestion forecasting, and simulation of decentralized/prosumer energy networks.

dataset_specification.description: Industrial pilot settings; Siemens Energy digital twins of real-world grid segments, TenneT congestion forecasting under variable wind and solar generation, and E.ON/Terra Quantum prosumer-network simulations. No explicit ticker/date-range style dataset details reported.

speedup_claims.caveats: Review-level discussion only; no quantitative performance results, benchmark comparisons, or measured speedup values are reported for smart-grid optimization, congestion forecasting, or prosumer-network simulation.

experiments.description: Quantum simulation for carbon-capture material discovery, including VQE-based zeolite adsorption studies, QPE for reaction kinetics, and QML screening of sorbents and membranes.

algorithm.variant: VQE/QPE/QML for CO2 adsorption and sorbent discovery

problem_formulation.objective_function: Estimate ground-state energies and molecular interactions relevant to CO2 adsorption, catalyst screening, and membrane design.

problem_instance.description: Carbon-capture R&D problems: zeolite-based CO2 adsorption, catalyst screening, and direct-air-capture material discovery.

dataset_specification.description: IBM Research simulations of CO2 interaction with zeolites; Pasqal/EDF/BASF CO2 sorption dynamics; Terra Quantum adsorption isotherm simulation; no explicit benchmark dataset or split reported.

speedup_claims.caveats: The chapter discusses quantum simulation for carbon-capture material discovery conceptually and cites industrial initiatives, but provides no numerical benchmark results, baseline comparisons, or measured speedup claims.

experiments.description: Quantum-enhanced energy-system innovation for batteries, renewable integration, and supply-chain optimization using VQE, QPE, QML, QAOA, reinforcement learning, and quantum vehicle routing.

algorithm.variant: Quantum-enhanced optimization and simulation for batteries, renewable forecasting, and energy logistics

problem_formulation.objective_function: Optimize battery chemistry simulation, renewable forecasting, energy trading, hydrogen production scheduling, and logistics routing.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Not specified; described as hybrid optimization and simulation workflows.

problem_instance.description: Energy-sector use cases including lithium-air and lithium-sulfur battery simulations, BP renewable forecasting and energy trading, ExxonMobil hydrogen/ammonia logistics, and supply-chain optimization.

dataset_specification.description: Industrial case studies and conceptual workflows; no explicit public dataset, feature set, or train/test split reported.

experiments.description: Quantum machine learning for climate modeling, including QFT, quantum Monte Carlo, quantum random walks, amplitude amplification, quantum kernels, and variational quantum classifiers.

algorithm.variant: Quantum machine learning for climate forecasting, anomaly detection, and land-cover classification

problem_formulation.objective_function: Improve climate forecast accuracy, uncertainty quantification, anomaly detection, and classification of geospatial data.

problem_instance.description: Climate and environmental analytics problems: medium-range weather forecasting, climate-risk simulation, land-use optimization, and satellite-derived land-cover classification.

dataset_specification.description: ECMWF hybrid quantum-classical forecasting efforts and Canadian QC2P satellite land-cover classification are mentioned, but no explicit dataset names, sizes, or splits are provided.

speedup_claims.caveats: Climate-modeling and quantum machine learning applications are described at a high level only; no quantitative experimental results, baselines, or scaling measurements are reported.

experiments.description: Hybrid quantum-classical AI/finance applications, including quantum attention deep Q-networks, quantum kernels, quantum reinforcement learning, and portfolio optimization on real quantum devices.

algorithm.variant: Quantum attention deep Q-networks and hybrid quantum-classical representation learning for finance and decision-making

problem_formulation.objective_function: Improve decision-making, risk-adjusted returns, and portfolio optimization / asset allocation.

problem_instance.description: Finance-oriented hybrid AI use cases: option pricing, portfolio optimization, and reinforcement-learning-based decision making.

dataset_specification.description: The chapter cites portfolio optimization on real quantum devices and financial applications such as option pricing, but does not provide a concrete dataset, asset universe, or evaluation split.

speedup_claims.caveats: Finance/portfolio-optimization-related quantum AI applications are mentioned only as examples. The chapter does not provide numerical portfolio metrics such as expected return, Sharpe ratio, CVaR, approximation ratio, feasibility percentage, or ground-state probability.
